breakdown.description: Labels the first FCC peak as (100), but the (100) reflection is forbidden for an FCC lattice. The first allowed FCC reflection is typically (111).
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the fundamental error in the prompt. The ground truth correctly identifies the first FCC peak as (111), because the (100) reflection is forbidden. The generated specification repeated the user's incorrect instruction to use the (100) peak, thereby failing to resolve the inconsistency.
